message.content:
This vertical editorial illustration features the masthead "TEMPO" in large, red, serif capitals. Above this, black text reads "INVESTIGASI: JEJAK PEMBANTAI SATWA LANGKA" and "KOMISARIS BUMN TITIPAN ISTANA," separated by a thin diagonal line. Below the masthead is the date "27 APRIL-3 MEI 2015." The main headline, "GOCEK POLITIK PSSI," is printed in bold, black sans-serif type.

A soccer ball is centrally located, encased within a large, irregular block of translucent, melting ice. The ball is traditional black and white, though its colors appear muted and slightly yellowed through the ice. A gold and blue emblem with the letters "PSSI" is visible on one of the white panels. The ice block is sitting on a white surface, surrounded by small puddles and droplets of liquid water. The background is solid white. Along the bottom, a red border contains a barcode, the price "RP 39.500," the website "WWW.TEMPO.CO," the phrase "MAJALAH BERITA MINGGUAN," and "ISSN: 0126 - 4273." A vertical red stripe runs down the left edge.
